(Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA without additional cleaning steps that could harm downstream applications.

11. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos that retain viability during the analysis.

13. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping using a method that does not harm the viability of the embryos.

17. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype without harming the viability of the embryos. 

19. (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated and does not compromise the viability of the embryos.
